content.title: General information for students | Università degli Studi di Siena
content.text: Tu sei qui General information for students How to reach SienaSienais located in the heart of Tuscanyamid a wide hilly landscape. Sienawelcomes its visitors with a Latin motto at the Porta Camollia "Cor Magis Tibi Saena Pandit" (Sienaopens its heart to you wider than this gate). Entry visa and temporary residency permitStudents outside of the European Union must request an entry visa from the Italian consulate for the purpose of study prior to arrival in Italy. Once in Italythey must apply for a permit to stay. Accommodation Study abroadThe opportunities in an international sphere for students of the University and for students in mobility University canteensThe University Canteens are run by the DSU-Toscana - Azienda regionale per il diritto allo studio universitario, which offers students low cost, full meals, with a varied menu. Medical facilitiesInformation on how to register with the Italian National Health Service (Servizio Sanitario Nazionale). Facilities for special needs studentsThe Office of Disabled Student Services works towards removing the cultural, physical and psychological barriers that can prevent disabled students from participating fully in university life. Insurance for studentsUniSi students, including those in international mobility, are covered by accident insurance and for third party liability during their study period at UniSi. Financial support for studentsOnce admitted to a degree course, students can apply for contributions (free meals, free lodging and scholarships) provided by the Tuscany Agency for University Services. Language coursesThe University Language Centre (Centro Linguistico di Ateneo - CLA) is responsible for the teaching of foreign languages to University students and staff. Italian Language Courses for Exchange StudentsThe University of Siena offers Italian language courses for Exchange students with an insufficient knowledge of Italian. SportThe University promotes sports for students by offering courses for free or at reduced rates in: basketball, football, volleyball, rugby, judo, weight training, fencing and tennis. Free timeThe Tuscany Agency for University Services (DSU-Toscana) promotes cultural and recreational activities for university students.
